video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.01.2026

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on building team chemistry with international players
quotes.excerpt: I really believe in building connection and connection can build connection through games and fun.
quotes.quote: It wasn't fair for the international guys, Mario and Tyrese and, you know, Tristan, he's from Holland. So it wasn't fair, so we got to give them another opportunity. But I really believe in building connection and connection can build connection through games and fun. It's not just basketball, it's not just team, and that's part of being here. In Spain, it's to build those connections. So tonight we'll do another fun night.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs are using their training camp in Spain to build team chemistry through activities like fun nights and pickleball to help international players feel more integrated.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the Cavaliers' rookie talent show
quotes.excerpt: I think tonight's the talent show, so the rookies have to, you know, impress me.
quotes.quote: I think tonight's the talent show, so the rookies have to, you know, impress me. Singing, dancing, cooking, they can do whatever they want.
quotes.social_post: The Cavs rookies have a talent show tonight in Spain. Kenny Atkinson says they have to impress him with singing, dancing, or whatever they choose.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on players learning to play pickleball
quotes.excerpt: Some guys have never played pickleball, they don't know that we don't have that sport in the States.
quotes.quote: Some guys have never played pickleball, they don't know that we don't have that sport in the States. So even the coaches, I saw a coach with a paddle, I'm like, when are you going? He goes, I'm going to play pickleball. I think we have a group that's embracing the opportunity here, not just on the court, but taking advantage of all the things Spain has to offer.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs are embracing the unique environment in Spain, noting that even the coaching staff is getting involved in local activities like pickleball.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the benefits of training camp in Spain
quotes.excerpt: When you change your environment, you have to be able to adapt and change.
quotes.quote: When you change your environment, you have to be able to adapt and change. Even the travel, you have to adapt and you have to get back on a sleep routine. So I think all these challenges are actually good for a team. We have FIBA referees, that's fine, the referees, maybe they call a little less fouls, which I think is great. The NBA has become more like FIBA with the fouls. So it's all a different environment.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson believes the challenges of training in Spain, including travel and adjusting to FIBA officiating, are beneficial for the team's growth and adaptability.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the unique atmosphere of the training facility
quotes.excerpt: It's really unique, an incredible, unique environment, obviously in a beautiful area.
quotes.quote: It's really unique, an incredible, unique environment, obviously in a beautiful area. I think that helps the spirits. I think that ambiance is, you know, guys are kind of more excited. If we were in our own facility, it'd be like, you know, they kind of do that all the time. So I think it gives them more, we say, jukes, right? Get more jukes coming at you in this place.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the unique atmosphere of the training facility in Spain is helping boost the spirits and excitement levels of the players compared to their usual routine.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the competitive nature of training camp
quotes.excerpt: The first thing is compete, the competitive spirit, then the second thing is understanding our concepts.
quotes.quote: The first thing is compete, the competitive spirit, then the second thing is understanding our concepts and how we play. And then, do they understand their role, right? Like where they are, depending who they're playing with. If they're with James, they might have to play one way, with Donovan another. See if they understand the people around you and that's hard for a young player.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the focus for Cavs players is understanding their roles based on who they are on the floor with, noting that playing alongside Donovan Mitchell requires a different approach than playing with others.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the versatility of the Cavaliers' roster
quotes.excerpt: Those guys help us become more versatile.
quotes.quote: Those guys help us become more versatile. We can only play the two bigs together for so long, so those lineups, I mean, watching Peyton today, he could easily play the four. Obviously, Mario can play the four and the three. It just gives you more versatility when you have one big on the floor. We love playing our two bigs together, we love that because they're in our top five best players, top four best players, but yeah, Peyton, Mario, those guys give us more versatility.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs are looking for more versatility beyond their two-big lineups, noting that Peyton and Mario are showing the ability to play the four to give the team more options.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson on the team's long-term growth and development
quotes.excerpt: It's a journey. We've changed our roster a little and probably raised our ceiling.
quotes.quote: It's a journey. We've changed our roster a little and probably raised our ceiling because our talent level is higher. But at the end of the day, you have to connect and find the right lineups, find the right chemistry and then the mental toughness and physical toughness to get to that next level. No one in our organization likes how we lost to the Knicks in the conference finals. So as competitors, all of us, it motivates you. You turn it almost into a positive, like man, we didn't do it, but we have the ability to get to that next step.
quotes.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs are motivated by their conference finals loss to the Knicks, stating that the organization is using that experience as a positive to fuel their push to the next level.
